<?php
$inputString = [];
$currentLine = 0;
while ($line = fgets(STDIN)) {
    $inputString[] = trim($line);
}
function readLine() {
    global $inputString, $currentLine;
    return $inputString[$currentLine++];
}
function main() {
    $parts = explode(" ", readLine());
    $total = intval($parts[0]);
    $front = intval($parts[1]);
    $back = intval($parts[2]);
    $diff = $total - $front;
    if ($diff > $back) {
        echo ($back + 1) . "\n";
    } else {
        echo $diff . "\n";
    }
}
main();
?>

<?php
$input = trim(file_get_contents("php://stdin"));
$lines = explode("\n", $input);
$lines = array_map('trim', $lines);
$currentLine = 0;

function readLine(&$lines, &$currentLine) {
    return $lines[$currentLine++];
}

function main(&$lines, &$currentLine) {
    $parts = explode(" ", readLine($lines, $currentLine));
    $parts = array_map('intval', $parts);
    list($total, $front, $back) = $parts;
    $diff = $total - $front;
    if ($diff > $back) {
        echo $back + 1;
    } else {
        echo $diff;
    }
}

main($lines, $currentLine);
?>

<?php
$input = [];
while (($line = fgets(STDIN)) !== false) {

}
$line = explode(' ', $input[0]);
$total = (int)$line[0];
$front = (int)$line[1];
$back = (int)$line[2];
$diff = $total - $front;
if ($diff > $back) {
    echo $back + 1;
} else {
    echo $diff;
}
?>

source_data.prob_desc_description: Petr stands in line of n people, but he doesn't know exactly which position he occupies. He can say that there are no less than a people standing in front of him and no more than b people standing behind him. Find the number of different positions Petr can occupy.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print the single number — the number of the sought positions.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The only line contains three integers n, a and b (0 ≤ a, b < n ≤ 100).
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteThe possible positions in the first sample are: 2 and 3 (if we number the positions starting with 1).In the second sample they are 3, 4 and 5.
